sentences.en: Congratulations, Catherine.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你，凯瑟琳。

sentences.en: I love that story.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个故事了。

sentences.en: Erin is now just going to kind of barge right into Andy's office,
sentences.zh: 接下来艾琳直接闯进了安迪的办公室，

sentences.en: and she's going to say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 她会说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We're breaking up.
sentences.zh: 我们分手吧。

sentences.en: I thought you were dead.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你死了呢。

sentences.en: You were gone for three months.
sentences.zh: 你一走就是三个月。

sentences.en: She really just kind of bears her soul to him here in this moment.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，她真的向他敞开了心扉。

sentences.en: He's kind of speechless.
sentences.zh: 他简直无言以对。

sentences.en: And then she leaves.
sentences.zh: 然后她就走了。

sentences.en: Well, we find out that David Wallace was on speakerphone and heard everything.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们发现大卫·华莱士当时开着免提，把一切都听得清清楚楚。

sentences.en: And he says, what's this about being gone for three months, Andy?
sentences.zh: 他说，安迪，这三个月不在是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And that's how the episode ends.
sentences.zh: 这一集就这样结束了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, there you have it.
sentences.zh: 好了，情况就是这样。

sentences.en: That's Couples Discount.
sentences.zh: 这就是“情侣折扣”。

sentences.en: This episode is going to set up quite a few big storylines,
sentences.zh: 这一集将为几条重要故事线埋下伏笔，

sentences.en: and I'm so excited for the next few episodes.
sentences.zh: 我太期待接下来的几集了。

sentences.en: And we have some fantastic guests coming up.
sentences.zh: 我们还请到了几位非常棒的嘉宾。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So thank you guys so much for rewatching and listening,
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家重温剧集并收听我们的节目，

sentences.en: for sending in your questions and comments.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家发来问题和评论。

sentences.en: Thank you to Steve Burgess for his call sheets and all his good production behind-the-scenes trivia.
sentences.zh: 感谢史蒂夫·伯吉斯提供通告单以及所有精彩的幕后制作花絮。

sentences.en: And thanks to Jordan and Cassie for helping us out this week,
sentences.zh: 感谢乔丹和卡茜这周对我们的帮助，

sentences.en: and we hope you guys have a great one.
sentences.zh: 希望大家过得愉快。

sentences.en: We'll see you next week.
sentences.zh: 我们下周见。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士》。

sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》由 Earwolf、珍娜·费舍和安吉拉·金斯利制作。

sentences.en: Our senior producer is Cassie Jerkins.
sentences.zh: 我们的高级制作人是卡茜·杰金斯。

sentences.en: Our audio engineer is Jordan Duffy,
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是乔丹·达菲，

sentences.zh: 我们的助理制作人是艾恩斯利·巴巴科。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿创作的《橡胶树》。
